WeddingTime.Text: at three o'clock in the afternoon

IntroText.Text: Please join us to celebrate the wedding of

LeadText.Text: Your presence at our celebration is the most meaningful gift we could receive.

BodyText.Text: If you would like to give us a gift, we would be truly grateful for a monetary contribution towards our future together.

Description.Text: A chance encounter that neither of us expected, but one that changed everything.
We discovered that the best journeys are the ones shared with someone special.
Building a home together and learning what it truly means to be a team.
A question asked, a joyful yes, and the beginning of forever.
The day we say "I do" surrounded by the people we love most.

IntroText.Text: A glimpse into the customs that make a Hungarian wedding truly unforgettable

Description.Text: Guests queue to dance with the bride for a brief moment, each placing money into a basket to wish the couple prosperity.
Friends playfully "kidnap" the bride, and the groom must complete humorous tasks or pay a ransom to win her back.
The bride tosses her bouquet to unmarried women, and the one who catches it is said to be the next to marry.
When guests clink and tap in unison, the newlyweds must kiss. The louder the clinking, the longer the kiss.
The couple cuts the wedding cake together, hand over hand, symbolizing their first shared act as husband and wife.

IntroText.Text: More details about the day will follow in due course.
